name: INUNEKO-SEIKATSU Co.,Ltd.
summary: INUNEKO-SEIKATSU Co.,Ltd. makes and sells pet food in Japan, mainly prepared packaged meals for cats and dogs. It also offers in-house health checkups and blood tests, veterinary clinics and grooming salons. Formerly Honest Food Co., Ltd., it was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Shinjuku.
